{"id":1563682364,"question_id":3,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1741175466,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"7 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1563682364/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters","memory":"11.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int lengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) {\n        unordered_map<char,int>mapping;\n        \n        int start = 0;\n        int len = 1;\n        \n        if(s == \"\") return 0;\n\n        for(int j = 0 ;j<s.size() ;j++)\n        {\n            if(mapping.find(s[j]) != mapping.end())\n            {\n                start = max(start , mapping[s[j]] + 1);\n            }\n            mapping[s[j]] = j;\n            len = max (len , j-start+1);\n        }\n    return len;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-substring-without-repeating-characters","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":409}
